biotools.summary: ProToDeviseR is an R package offering an automated protein topology scheme generator. It allows users to create publication-ready schemes from database accession numbers, prediction server results, or manually prepared tables, offering a graphical user interface via R Shiny and incorporating an enhanced version of Pfam’s domain generator.
